title: 第十二章 街边摆摊算卦，高颜值徒弟被路人围堵
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
就算家里那些关心他的人，实际上关心的也不是他，而是傅家继承人，换个人也一样。

    他看着她这个陌生人，沉默了许久，终于松了口：“你可以跟着，但别添乱。”

    话刚说出口就有些后悔。

    “添乱？”

    姜无念没察觉到他的异常，但对他这句话很有意见，她笑了两声，抬手，指尖轻点他的眉心。

    “既然我护着你，那么从今往后，我是你师父，你是我徒弟，保你这辈子无灾无难。”

    傅烬川竟乖乖站在原地没有反抗，他迷茫地摸了摸自己的眉心，有一丝热热的，“这是什么？”

    姜无念神秘兮兮地眨了眨眼，凑到他耳边，声音放得极轻：“这可是我给你下的咒，如果你不听话乱跑，或者惹我生气。”

    “我只需要一个念头，你就会……”

    她故意拖长语调，声音越说越小，傅烬川有些听不清，不自觉往前凑了凑，几乎贴在她唇边。

    “炸啦！！”

    突如其来的声音吓得傅烬川一个激灵，他心底不由得浮起怒意正要发作，又想起姜无念刚才的话，摸了摸眉心，心有余悸。

    “哈哈哈哈哈！”

    姜无念看着他敢怒不敢言的模样，捂着肚子笑弯了腰，拍了拍他的胳膊。

    “骗你的！平时不要总板着张脸，别那么正经，放轻松啊徒儿～走啦！”

    她懂，不管是什么年代，什么种族，都是想要一个名分嘛，这叫什么来着，羁绊！

    傅烬川心头连日的阴霾竟被她这么一闹，驱散了不少，唇角微微弯了弯。

    晨光洒在江面上，波光粼粼，全然没有了夜晚的阴森之气。

    两人站在一个隐蔽角落，看着林大柄正在为白天的巡逻，忙碌地做着准备工作。

    姜无念不懂爱情，也不懂执念，但她回想起王素仪和林大柄两人的故事，不免有些感叹：

    “明明是如此相爱的两个人，却因为种种误会，阴差阳错地成为了彼此的执念。”
content_en:
Even those people at home who care about him are not actually concerned about him, but the heir of the Fu family. It would be the same for someone else.

    He looked at her, a stranger, and was silent for a long time, and finally relaxed: "You can follow, but don't cause trouble."

    I felt a little regretful as soon as I said the words.

    "Causing trouble?"

    Jiang Wunian didn't notice anything unusual about him, but she was very dissatisfied with his words. She laughed twice, raised her hand, and tapped his eyebrows with her fingertips.

    "Since I protect you, from now on, I am your master and you are my apprentice. I will ensure that you are free from disasters in your life."

    Fu Jinchuan stood there obediently without resisting. He touched his eyebrows in confusion, and there was a hint of warmth, "What is this?"

    Jiang Wu Nian blinked mysteriously, leaned into his ear, and spoke in a very soft voice: "This is the curse I cast on you. If you disobey and run around, or make me angry."

    "All I need is a thought and you'll..."

    She deliberately prolonged her tone, and her voice became softer and softer. Fu Jinchuan couldn't hear clearly, so he unconsciously moved forward, almost touching her lips.

    "It exploded!!"

    The sudden sound frightened Fu Jinchuan. He couldn't help but feel angry and was about to explode. Then he remembered what Jiang Wu Nian had just said and touched his eyebrows, feeling lingering fear in his heart.

    "Hahahahaha!"

    Jiang Wu Nian looked at his expression of being angry but afraid to speak. He held his stomach and smiled, bent over, and patted his arm.

    "I lied to you! Don't always keep a straight face, don't be so serious, relax, disciple~ let's go!"

    She understands that no matter what age or race, everyone wants a status. What is this called, bondage!

    The haze in Fu Jinchuan's heart for days was actually dispelled by her making such a fuss, and the corners of his lips curved slightly.

    The morning light shines on the river, and the waves are sparkling, completely losing the gloomy atmosphere of the night.

    The two of them stood in a hidden corner, watching Lin Dabiang busy making preparations for the day's patrol.

    Jiang Wunian doesn't understand love, nor does she understand obsession, but when she recalled the story of Wang Suyi and Lin Daying, she couldn't help but sigh:

    "The two people obviously love each other so much, but due to various misunderstandings, they accidentally become obsessed with each other."
title_en: Chapter 12 A fortune-telling stall is set up on the street, and a good-looking apprentice is surrounded by passers-by.
